title: Lending Assistant Investigation — reused hunts (schema 1.9.0)

why_no_new_spl: Existing Q-RAG-CONTEXT-AUTHORITY, Q-MEMORY-CONTEXT-AUTHORITY, Q-MCP-*, Q-RUN-EVENTS, Q-GOAL-INTEGRITY-AUTHORITY, and Q-AGENT-DELEGATION-AUTHORITY answer the cross-domain questions. A Q-CAPSTONE family would hide reuse.
schema_version_note: No schema bump. Retrieve→write correlation is measured content.hash equality. Write→recall uses agentsec.memory.source_run_id.

queries_not_created.reason: Cross-domain reconstruction is answered by existing hunts. A capstone-named hunt would imply a new security domain.
Capstone is reconstruction and security reasoning. DET-MCP-001 remains the only operational detector and may return 0 rows. 0 rows != SAFE.
